overall_assessment: Fulltext extraction works well for NIH: all 10 fetched pages are clean, complete copies of the plan with the facts box, correct year and readable structure, and the uncaptured page text is only breadcrumb, responsible-person name and FS timestamp. The only weakness is that the reading list is empty or a stub because the pensum is not on the fetched page; 56% of offerings are 404 (plausibly not offered).

findings.description: The Kjernelitteratur section holds no actual literature: a one-line placeholder ('Pensumliste for våren 2025.', 'Se emnearkivet'), or an empty heading at the end of LKI221. The page text not captured shows no literature lines, so the actual reading list is not on the fetched page (likely a link or a separate resource). The extraction is faithful, but reading_list will be empty/stub for these courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: NIH course pages link to the pensum list externally (or via JS) rather than inline; selector #vrtx-fs-emne-content captures only the heading and stub.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept as a source limitation and let section extraction treat stub-only reading_list as empty; optionally check whether the pensum link target is harvestable.

findings.description: 103 of 184 offerings return 404 (only 81 fetched). Many are plausibly not-offered or new courses (status Nytt), but the share is large and cannot be verified from the packet whether the URL pattern (/studier/emner/YYYY/var|host/code.html) is wrong for some years.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: plan_years = url builds a URL per offering; NIH only publishes pages for semesters in which the course exists, so non-offered semesters 404.
findings.suggested_fix: Spot check a few 404 URLs for courses known to be offered (e.g. LKI152 spring 2024) in a browser; if they exist elsewhere, adjust the URL builder in R/add_course_url.R.
